# Spring Boot Migration
Modernize Spring Boot while preparing the application for containerized execution on Azure AKS.
Inspect Spring Boot/Spring Framework versions, Java, dependencies, javax/jakarta usage, configuration, security, persistence, messaging, serialization, tests and CI.
Use supported upgrade paths. Preserve security and API behavior. Avoid unrelated refactoring.
Ensure AKS readiness: external configuration, external secrets, health/readiness endpoints, graceful shutdown and stdout/stderr logging.
Validate compile, tests, packaging, container build and startup/smoke tests.
Report versions, breaking changes, configuration/security changes, test evidence and AKS readiness.
